dish_en: Suan Cai Yu, Sichuan fish with pickled mustard greens
product_desc: a finished bowl of Sichuan pickled-cabbage fish soup, the broth pale gold and slightly cloudy, thick white fish slices curled in it with pickled mustard greens and a scattering of green peppercorns, no packaging and no text anywhere in frame
cook: a Sichuanese cook in his thirties in a dark apron, sleeves rolled, working fast
kitchen: a home kitchen with stainless surfaces and a wok burner, wooden boards along the counter, neutral daylight from a window on the left, warm only in the shadows
prep_subject: thick fish fillet slices cut on a 45 degree angle, pale and glossy from a marinade of rice wine, salt, white pepper and corn starch, laid out overlapping on a plate. Beside them rinsed pickled mustard greens in short lengths, whole Sichuan peppercorns, sliced garlic, ginger and pickled chillies, each separate
prep_defines: the 45 degree angle and thickness of the fish slices, and the marinade gloss on them
cook_vessel: a carbon steel wok over a gas flame
cook_subject: the wok partway through, pickled mustard greens fried dry and darkened with Sichuan peppercorns, garlic, ginger and pickled chilli among them, boiling water just poured in and clouding to a pale gold broth. No fish is in the wok yet
cook_negatives: fish added before the broth is built, fish slices broken apart, a red chilli-oil hotpot look, a thick or starchy soup, raw pickled greens dropped straight into water
vessel_start: empty except for a film of oil just beginning to shimmer, no food in it yet
hero_subject: the finished dish in a wide bowl, broth pale gold and slightly cloudy, thick white fish slices curled and intact on top, pickled mustard greens beneath them, a scatter of green Sichuan peppercorns and sliced chilli, fresh coriander over the top and a bowl of plain rice beside it
hero_setting: a wooden kitchen table in the same home, neutral daylight
story: pickled greens fried dry with peppercorns and garlic in an empty wok
boiling water in, then the marinated fish slid in one at a time
poured into the bowl, hot oil over the top, coriander scattered
first_heat: The pickled greens hit the bare hot steel and go from limp to dry and fragrant in seconds, their edges darkening as the moisture cooks off.
transform: the fried greens and aromatics take on colour, boiling water goes in and turns the wok from dry to a pale gold cloudy broth, and the marinated fish slices are slid in one at a time and go from translucent grey to opaque white, curling as they set without breaking apart.
lift: A wide slotted spoon enters from the left, slides under two fish slices and lifts them clear of the broth to the centre of frame. The flesh is opaque white and holding together in one piece, broth running off in a thin stream.
plate: The hands of <Subject 1> enter from the top of frame holding the wok by its handle, tip it once over the wide bowl, and the broth, fish and pickled greens slide out together. The hands withdraw out of frame.
final_lift: A hand enters from the right holding chopsticks, takes one thick white fish slice, lifts it clear of the broth and holds it steady at the centre of frame, the flesh flaking slightly under its own weight.

beats.c1s1: <Subject 1> draws the plate of marinated fish and the pickled greens toward them in one movement.
beats.c1s2: Both hands of <Subject 1> turn the fish slices through the marinade until evenly glossed, then slide the plate to the near edge and set the greens down apart from it. The fish and the greens never touch.
beats.c1s3: The hands of <Subject 1> enter from the top of frame carrying the rinsed pickled mustard greens, Sichuan peppercorns, garlic and ginger, tip them into the empty hot wok in one movement, and withdraw straight up out of frame empty. No fish goes in during this shot.
beats.c3s2: The hand of <Subject 1> enters from the top of frame with a ladle of smoking hot oil and pours it over the scattered chilli and peppercorns on the surface in one pass, then withdraws straight up out of frame. The oil hits and the aromatics flare and darken where it lands.

clip02_shot1: [Shot 1] Locked-off close-up at wok height, 50mm feel, continuing directly from <Picture 1>. The wok of <Picture 4> fills the lower two thirds of frame over its burner, which stays visible at the bottom of frame throughout. The pickled greens from clip 01 are fried dry and darkened with the peppercorns and garlic among them. The hands of <Subject 1> enter from the top of frame with a jug of boiling water, pour it into the wok in one steady stream until the greens are submerged, and withdraw straight up out of frame empty. The wok goes from dry to a pale gold cloudy broth at a hard boil. No fish is in this shot. The camera does not move at any point in this shot, and the framing does not drift.
negatives_global: a red chilli-oil hotpot look, a thick starchy soup, fish broken into shreds, fish added before the broth exists, whole uncut fish
sound_01: A home kitchen with a low extractor hum. In the first shot, a ceramic plate sliding on a steel counter. In the second shot, the wet slap of marinated fish slices being turned by hand. In the third shot, a gas burner rising, then the hard dry rustle and crackle of pickled greens hitting bare hot steel. No speech.
sound_02: A dry crackling fry at first, then a heavy rush as boiling water goes in and settles into a hard rolling boil. In the third shot, a slotted spoon lifting and broth running back in a thin stream. No speech.
sound_03: A home kitchen. In the first shot, broth and fish sliding from a wok into a ceramic bowl. In the second shot, a sharp violent hiss as smoking oil is poured over chilli and peppercorns. In the third shot, chopsticks closing on fish, and a rice bowl set down. No speech.
music: A taut Sichuan bed: plucked strings over a low drum pulse, sharp and a little sour, lifting as the hot oil lands.
